summary: Alpine Income Property Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose amendments to its existing preferred stock at-the-market offering program, adding Cantor Fitzgerald and Huntington Securities as additional sales agents. The company may issue and sell up to $35M of its 8.00% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at a $25.00 liquidation preference. The amendment updates prior distribution agreements dated December 2025 with ten other agents. This is a routine shelf takedown update, not a special situation event—no merger, tender, activist, or restructuring is involved. No deal terms or board actions are present.
